description: Writes to the user's Lab: ask the user before calling, then pass confirm: true. Start paper trading a saved strategy: from now on every signal of its wallets is scored against the real order book (no orders, no keys, no money). One active run per strategy. Needs POLYRANK_API_KEY (plan feature paper_trading).

confirm.description: Required: true, and only after the user agreed to this call in the conversation.
